headline: KPI-recompute-consistency audit of amphora-ip-fto-guard's declared primary value path metrics.unresolved_technical_categories (pinned fixture SHA 52ada09074f435d5...): H0 'the module's standing signed audit receipts (landscape-integrity-v1, all-elements-rule-v1, cpc-coverage-v1) faithfully reconstruct the SAME metric the live checked Rust runtime populates' is REFUTED. Live runtime (AssuranceCapability::new + evaluate(), real compiled code path, 4 candidate scenarios, two-replay byte-identical) emits 75 (source: len(claim_chart_categories where not_fto==true) = 75); the 3 standing, unsuperseded audit receipts each assert unresolved_technical_categories_recomputed={'landscape-integrity-v1': 54, 'all-elements-rule-v1': 54} (source: count of families rows with reads_on_ours=='UNCLEAR / not FTO' = 54). Same pinned fixture SHA cited by all parties (True). The two source arrays (claim_chart_categories, 75 entries; families, 60 entries) are structurally distinct and were never reconciled after the 2026-08-03 R-B01 repair switched the live runtime onto claim_chart_categories -- all 3 standing receipts predate that repair (2026-07-27/28/29) and were never re-run against the repaired runtime.

inputs.probe_harness: /tmp/kpi_recompute_probe (standalone cargo bin, path deps: amphora-core, amphora-assurance-capabilities)

non_circularity: Both candidate recomputations (a: claim_chart_categories not_fto count: 75; b: families UNCLEAR count: 54) are counted fresh in this script directly from fixture bytes on disk, not copied from any prior receipt. The live-runtime value is read from a freshly compiled, freshly executed standalone probe binary (path deps only, no re-implementation of evaluate_ip_fto_guard), run twice for byte-identical replay, independent of the R-B01 repair's own probe output (though found to agree with it -- 75 in both cases, 8 months... days apart under the same repaired code).

proposed_followups.defect: landscape-integrity-v1, all-elements-rule-v1, and cpc-coverage-v1 (all dated 2026-07-27..29, all pre-dating the 2026-08-03 R-B01 repair that first wired metrics.unresolved_technical_categories to the live runtime) each assert unresolved_technical_categories_recomputed=54 from a families-UNCLEAR count, but the repaired live runtime actually emits 75 from a claim_chart_categories count -- a live, mechanically verifiable disagreement on the value of the module's own declared 'primary value path' KPI, with no reconciling receipt and no RETRACTION-INDEX.md entry.
proposed_followups.proposed_done_criterion: Either (a) supersede the 3 pre-repair receipts' kpi_reconstruction sections with a corrected recompute against claim_chart_categories and add a RETRACTION-INDEX.md entry, or (b) if families-UNCLEAR is the intended semantic, file a repair against the R-B01 runtime fix in amphora-assurance-capabilities to recompute from families UNCLEAR instead of claim_chart_categories, reconciling docs/mission.md's KPI register description either way.

purpose: Determine whether the 3 standing (non-superseded) AUDIT_ONLY receipts that reconstruct amphora-ip-fto-guard's declared primary KPI value path from the pinned fixture remain consistent with what the live, code-checked Rust runtime actually emits for that exact metric, post the 2026-08-03 R-B01 metric-schema-parity repair.
theory_reference: Metric consistency / single-source-of-truth principle for a declared 'primary value path' KPI (docs/mission.md: 'the primary value path is metrics.unresolved_technical_categories', 'populated by the live checked Rust runtime'); DSSE receipt supersession discipline per this module's own RETRACTION-INDEX.md ('Original artifacts are never rewritten' -- but also never left silently contradicted by a later live-runtime change without a reconciling receipt).
